# Day Zero Solutions

> Australian software studio building operations software for regulated, high-stakes industries: aged care and healthcare, restaurants, and food trucks. The through-line: from Day Zero to Day One. Software grounded in the customer's own live data, regulation-aware, that shows its working, with a human making the final call.

Day Zero Solutions Pty Ltd (ACN 698 240 907, ABN 95 698 240 907) is a Brisbane, Australia software studio. It builds vertical operations software for operators who carry real accountability, aged-care directors of nursing and providers, restaurant owner-operators and head chefs, and food-truck operators. The products are grounded in each customer's live data and are regulation-aware (IDDSI, Aged Care Quality Standards, AN-ACC, HACCP), positioning AI as decision support that cites its sources, with the human making the final call, never as an unaccountable black box.

## Products

- [NutriCare](https://nutri-care.app): Dietary management and care intelligence for aged care and healthcare. IDDSI texture and allergen conflict detection at the point of order, clinical nutrition (MUST / GLIM / ESPEN 2022), SIRS incident logging, FHIR R4 export, family portal, and multi-site operator dashboards. Pricing from A$10 per resident per month.
- [RestroAI](https://restroai.app): AI-native restaurant operating system. Inventory, procurement with purchase orders, goods receipt, 3-way matching and invoice OCR, recipe costing, menu engineering, online ordering, kitchen display, HACCP, and food-cost intelligence. Pricing from A$49 per month.
- [QueueZero](https://queuezero.app): Order-ahead and queue-busting for food trucks and pop-ups. QR-code menus, live wait times, order-ahead, kitchen display and now-serving board, print-ready QR signage, with no app and no hardware, and 0% commission. A$49 per month or A$490 per year.
